As a warehouse employee in Veghel, you work full-time from 11:30 AM to 8:00 PM. You ensure that medicines and medical supplies leave the warehouse quickly and correctly. You work accurately because every detail matters. This job is perfect for you if you like to take responsibility and want to make a difference in healthcare.
On a typical day, you pick orders using a hand scanner. You check the orders for accuracy and prepare everything for shipment. You make sure the right products reach pharmacies and healthcare institutions on time. You work together with colleagues in the warehouse but can also work independently.
Are you motivated and do you like to get to work? Then we are looking for you! With your effort, you really make a difference for many people. Apply today and become part of a professional team in an important sector! 🚀

- You already bring logistic experience with you
- You speak and write English
- You work accurately and responsibly
- You are motivated and have a positive attitude
- You can work well both in a team and independently

High-tech machinery, daytime shifts and plenty of opportunities. A role with perspective, a competitive salary, and the space to develop yourself. Wie zoeken we? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building you are accurate, practical and quality-oriented. You understand better than anyone how important it is that every machine delivers exactly what the customer requires. You work independently or together with colleagues on assembling and testing complex modules and systems. You solve problems quickly and proactively, and you naturally enjoy supporting your colleagues and sharing your knowledge. Technicial background or education Interest in fine mechanics and precision work Accuracy and strong attention to detail Good command of English and the ability to follow instructions Wat bieden wij je? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building, you can of course expect something in return for your efforts. You will have a varied role in daytime shifts within a dedicated team of specialists. There is plenty of room for development, training, and career growth. In addition, you will work in a pleasant, informal environment with opportunities for team activities. A gross monthly salary between €3.000 and €4.200 based on a 40-hour week A one-year contract with the client, with prospects for a permanent position 27 vacation days and 13 additional days off Participation in the PME pension fund (Metalektro) Informal working atmosphere with opportunities for team activities Functieomschrijving As an Assembly Technician in high-tech machine building you will assemble and test advanced machines used for wafer processing with plasma technology. These machines are essential to the semiconductor industry, a vital sector powering the technology behind everything from smartphones and medical devices to cars, smart appliances and sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a cleanroom environment. Depending on the size of the machine you will either handle th

build independently or together with one or two colleagues. While some standard machines are delivered, no two machines are ever the same since each one is fully customized to the client’s specifications. Once you know the machines inside out you will also perform the final testing and prepare the accompanying test reports, making sure the machines deliver exactly as promised. This is a highly responsible role as you will be working with precision equipment. You will also support less experienced colleagues, contributing directly to the team and the quality of the machines. Your work makes an immediate difference in the performance of these products. Assembling high-tech machines and components in a cleanroom environment Testing and inspecting the functionality of the systems Identifying and resolving technical issues during the assembly process Adapting machines to meet specific customer requirements and needs Where will you be working? You will join an innovative company in the semiconductor industry, based in Nijmegen. This high-tech organisation develops and builds machines for the global market, with locations in Europe, China and the United States. The production department in Nijmegen consists of around 20 colleagues who share a passion for technology. The atmosphere is informal and supportive – you are never on your own. Ready to take the next step as an assembly technician in high-tech? Apply today and we will get in touch with you soon.

As a Warehouse Operator at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you play a key role in ensuring a smooth and efficient logistics process. You will join a supportive and collaborative team where communication, flexibility, and teamwork are highly valued.

In this all-round position, you will work across multiple warehouse departments and, when required, at different Samsung SDS locations in Tilburg.  
Your responsibilities may include physically active tasks such as order picking, packing, and preparing shipments, as well as administrative duties like inspecting incoming goods, managing inventory, and processing data in warehouse management systems. This variety allows you to develop a broad range of skills while keeping your work challenging and engaging.

Flexibility is an important part of the role. You will primarily work in a two-shift schedule (morning and evening shifts), but during peak periods you may also be required to work night shifts and occasional Saturdays. 

Working hours range from 20 to 37.5 hours per week, offering flexibility while supporting the operational needs of the business.

Ready to become part of a global organization and contribute to efficient warehouse operations? We'd love to hear from you!

You enjoy staying active and thrive in an international working environment. You are reliable, flexible, and enjoy working as part of a team. You're comfortable adapting to different tasks, departments, and warehouse locations.

Requirements:

- You have your own transportation to travel to Tilburg.
- You have a good command of the English language.
- You are available to work full-time.
- You are physically fit and able to perform warehouse activities.
- You are flexible and willing to work in a three-shift schedule, including evening shifts, night shifts when required, and occasional Saturdays.
- You are a team player with a proactive attitude.
- You are willing to work across multiple departments and warehouse locations.

As an experienced orbital welder, you play a key role in developing and producing prototypes and initial production runs. You work closely with engineers to evaluate new designs, determine the correct welding method, and apply it directly in the cleanroom production area. Your craftsmanship sets the standard for the rest of the production process. Thanks to your technical insight, designs are elevated to a higher level even before they reach the production line.

This role isn’t just about welding. It’s an opportunity to work daily with the latest technologies such as welding robots, cobots, lasers, and 3D printers. You bring knowledge and experience as an orbital welder perhaps also as a TIG welder or fabrication technician and you know better than anyone how to read technical drawings and translate them into top-quality work. Your structured working style, digital skills, and eagerness to learn make a real difference in a production environment where innovation is the standard.

You’ll join a team full of expertise, but also one that gives you the space to grow. There’s plenty of attention given to your development, initiative is appreciated, and your contribution to the final product is visible, tangible, and measurable. You’re not just creating metal connections here, you’re building solutions that make a global impact.

- You have demonstrable work experience at a comparable level
- You have experience with orbital welding
- You speak fluent English or Dutch

Are you interested in working with IT hardware and enjoy a practical role in a production environment? Do you like working with technology, paying attention to details, and being part of a team? Then this could be the right opportunity for you!

A growing company in Eindhoven is looking for a Production IT Employee. In this role, you will support the refurbishment process and help ensure that IT equipment is processed correctly and meets quality standards.

Your tasks include receiving and checking incoming hardware, testing devices, installing software, securely removing data, and keeping accurate records. You will also remove components from server racks and register them in the ERP system.

This role requires focus, precision, and the ability to perform repetitive tasks. You will work in a hands-on environment and be on your feet for most of the day.

- Basic English for communication with colleagues
- Physically fit and able to stand throughout the day
- No IT experience required; interest in electronics is a plus
- Comfortable with simple logistics tasks like sorting, checking, and organizing electronic items
- Accurate and able to follow basic logistics processes

Are you looking for an active and varied job in logistics? DHL Supply Chain in Beringe is looking for enthusiastic warehouse operators who are ready to roll up their sleeves. Whether you have experience with an EPT, OPT, reach truck, or forklift, we have various opportunities available within our modern distribution center.

Together with a dedicated team, you will ensure that all logistics processes run smoothly. No two days are the same. You will work with a variety of products, orders, and logistics activities, making your job both challenging and diverse. Experience is a plus, but it is certainly not required. With the right motivation, we are happy to teach you the rest.

Depending on your experience and preferences, your responsibilities may include:

- Picking orders using an EPT, OPT, forklift, and/or reach truck.
- Moving goods throughout the warehouse.
- Loading and unloading trucks.
- Operating a reach truck and/or forklift.
- Checking goods for quality and quantity.
- Preparing orders for shipment.
- Contributing to a safe, efficient, and well-organized warehouse environment.

You will work accurately, pay close attention to quality, and ensure that customers receive their orders on time.

Starting September 14, you will begin an extensive onboarding and training period on the work floor. From September 28 through October 16, you will therefore work the day shift from 08:00 to 17:00, allowing you to become familiar with all tasks and processes.

After the training period, you will work one of the following shifts:

- 08:00 - 17:00
- 11:00 - 20:00

You can choose to work a fixed shift or be available for both shifts. If you choose both, you will work on a weekly rotating schedule.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English.
- Experience in logistics.
- Proficiency in working with computer systems and Microsoft Excel.
- A flexible and motivated attitude.
- Own transportation.
- A valid EPT, OPT, and/or reach truck certificate is an advantag

As a Warehouse employee for GXO, you perform different tasks. From offloading trucks and storing goods on the right location, stock management, picking orders, checking orders or loading trucks with outgoing packages, it is all part of the job. You will be working in an international team in a warm atmosphere. GXO celebrates succeses, so don't be surprised if they hand out icecreams during summer time, or a cake for someones birthday. You will work in a fixed schedule together with your teamleader. One week morning shift from 06.00 to 15.00, next week afternoon shift from 13.00 until 22.00 hrs. Working days are monday to friday. On occasion they work Saturdays. As a warehouse employee you are the key to our clients succes. Its important you pay attention to detail, because the packages you collect are part of a combination. One wrong package and the whole system does not work. 

- You have to have your own transportation (public transport not available at beginning of the shift)
- Full time available from Monday to Friday, in two shifts.
- Physically fit and comfortable with active work (you lift packages up to 25 kg). 
- Speaks good English or Dutch
- VOG required (application will be done after your start).

Are you an experienced reachtruck driver looking for flexible shift work? We have two shifts available at a large cold storage warehouse in Maastricht, choose what fits your schedule best.

Your responsibilities

- Operating a heated reach truck to move and store goods
- Order picking and ensuring correct product placement
- Identifying and reporting stock discrepancies
- Working according to safety procedures in a cold environment (-25°C)
- Collaborating with colleagues and supervisors

Working in the cold? No problem, thermal clothing is provided and your reach truck is heated.

Available shifts (Monday to Friday)

As a nursery worker, you’ll be involved in the daily cultivation and care of our plants. You’ll primarily work with machinery, both outdoors and in our greenhouse and shade house, and will be responsible for transplanting and watering the crops. You’ll keep the plants healthy by removing weeds both mechanically and by hand, regularly monitor their growth, and identify any pests or a​bnormalities. In addition, you will assist with various maintenance tasks at the nursery to ensure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll also play a key role in logistics and production processes. You’ll harvest the plants, process them by pruning and dividing them, and prepare them for shipment by labeling and packing them according to orders. It’s a versatile role where no two days are the same, and where you’ll actively contribute to the entire process from plant to delivery.

Are you someone who enjoys varied work, has a practical mindset, and loves working in a green environment? Then we invite you to join our team and help us grow healthy, beautiful plants together.

- Flexible, motivated, and a team player
- Willing to do physical work, partly outdoors
- You can work independently
- Fluent in Dutch or English

You are responsible for processing returns and accurately registering everything in the system. You pick, pack, and prepare orders for shipment. You also help receive, check, and process incoming goods administratively.
You work day shifts from Monday to Friday, at least two of the following shifts: 06:00 – 15:00, 09:00 – 18:00, or 13:30 – 22:30. During busy periods, you help out where needed. Together with your colleagues, you make sure the warehouse runs smoothly. You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work.
Are you accurate, flexible, and a real team player? Do you enjoy working with big brands? Then this position is perfect for you! Apply quickly and join this enthusiastic team 🚀.

- At least VMBO working and thinking level

- You work accurately and have an eye for detail
